== frame after_unset_env cursor=4,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ export TMP_SAME_LINE=present
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ unset TMP_SAME_LINE; env | grep TMP_SAME_LINE
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 export
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 unset
@4 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
